messages:
IncidentBot: PAGE — Incident 3123456789 — High latency / partial errors in us-west-2. Pages: maria, sam. Auto-acknowledged.

maria: Taking handoff. Quick summary: routed traffic to fallback model variant to mitigate. Customer-facing: tail latency spiked to ~7s, some 500s reported. No data exfiltration. Starting RCA writeup and evidence collection.

sam: Confirmed fallback executed and mitigation logs uploaded to incident bucket. Redacted keys. Link: s3://redwood-incident-archives/3123456789/mitigation.log

lena: Scheduling postmortem — propose tomorrow 10:30 PT. Who will own the timeline and the draft?

vikram: I'll own the timeline and initial technical writeup. Need KV-cache dumps + autoscaler metrics + model rollout history.

jessica: I'll own customer impact evidence and support tickets. Noted 4 customers opened alerts during the window. I'll gather ticket links and sample errors.

maria: Action items from this thread (quick):
- timeline owner: vikram
- evidence + support: jessica
- infra logs + caches: sam
- legal review for comms: priya-legal

priya-legal: I'll review comms and any SLA/contract notes once impact summary is posted. Heads up: one contract may allow SLA credit; will flag if needed.

sam: Uploaded: autoscaler.csv and cache-dump.tar.gz to s3://redwood-incident-archives/3123456789/
Snippet from mitigation.log:
```
2026-03-16T22:03:47Z  ERROR  model-server  OOM while allocating KV cache
2026-03-16T22:04:01Z  WARN   router        retrying to fallback-model-v2
2026-03-16T22:04:05Z  INFO   router        serve from fallback-model-v2
```

vikram: Draft timeline (initial):
22:02:00 UTC — autoscaler starts approaching max capacity under burst.
22:03:20 UTC — request queue starts to increase; retries observed.
22:03:47 UTC — model-server on node i-0abc OOM on KV allocation.
22:04:01 UTC — router attempts fallback to fallback-model-v2.
22:04:05 UTC — majority of traffic served by fallback; errors for some in-flight requests.
22:06:30 UTC — latency begins to stabilize.
22:08:00 UTC — metrics within normal range.

jessica: Customer impact summary (initial): 4 customers reported 500 errors and high tail latency between 22:03–22:09 UTC. Estimated affected requests ~4.2k. Support tickets: #3421, #3422, #3423, #3424. Draft comms placed at /docs/incident-3123456789/comms-draft.md

maria: Gap analysis: we still need — A) per-machine KV cache stats during spike (sam) B) full autoscaler event timeline (sam) C) model rollout and any recent config changes (deploy metadata) D) per-request trace ids for the fallback period (we appear to be missing some)

sam: I have A+B uploaded. Model rollout metadata: looks like last model hotfix was 2026-03-14 03:12 UTC (no config change at deploy time). Cache dumps are in the bucket.

vikram: Noted a telemetry gap: per-request trace ids for requests that errored during fallback are absent for ~90s window. Adding a work item to instrument and persist trace id mapping during fallback windows.

lena: Postmortem meeting confirmed: tomorrow 10:30 PT. Invitees: eng runtime, infra, support, legal. Agenda: timeline, contributing factors, evidence review, action items + owners, customer comms. Meeting link: https://meet.redwood.com/room/incident-3123456789

jessica: I'll bring support logs and representative stack traces to the meeting. Also will share the list of affected customers so we can prioritize comms.

maria: For the RCA writeup: I'll draft Impact Summary and Contributing Factors. Vikram — add Technical Timeline. Sam — compile Evidence & Logs. Jessica — add Customer Impact section and support ticket excerpts. After initial drafts we'll do peer review in this thread and aim for sign-off. Who signs off on final RCA?

lena: Ops lead approval for the RCA, legal approves customer-facing text. I'll be the final sign-off for the RCA acceptance.

vikram: Pushed initial timeline draft and a PR to GH: https://github.com/redwood/internals/pull/incident-3123456789

maria: Can everyone review the PR and related docs by EOD tomorrow (17:00 PT)? :thumbsup:

priya-legal: I can review customer comms by EOD tomorrow. Please ping when the impact summary is ready.

sam: Mitigation follow-up: added temporary autoscaler headroom rule to reduce OOM risk. Action: revert when the model quantization and kv-cache patch lands. Owner: sam. ETA: 48h.

vikram: Proposed long-term fixes to include in Actions:
- enforce per-request trace ids for fallback paths (owner: vikram, ETA: 7d)
- add regression test for large KV allocations and OOM detection in CI (owner: eng-runtime, ETA: 14d)
- add autoscaler safety buffer and alert on queue growth (owner: sam, ETA: 3d)

jessica: Added a support-side runbook item: alert if 95th latency > 6s for > 1 minute (owner: jessica).

maria: Action items recap (owners + ETA):
- Vikram: timeline PR + fallback trace instrumentation (24h / 7d)
- Sam: KV stats + autoscaler metrics + temp rule removal plan (24h / 48h)
- Jessica: support evidence + customer list + comms draft (24h)
- Priya-legal: legal review of comms (EOD tomorrow)
- Lena: run postmortem meeting and sign-off (meeting time)
- Maria: assemble RCA draft and consolidate peer feedback (24h)

maria: Please tag me when PRs/docs are ready for review. Thanks all for quick turnaround. :white_check_mark:

vikram: I'll follow up with a small PR adding the missing instrumentation and link to regression test plan.

jessica: I'll upload sanitized stack traces and ticket excerpts to the incident bucket after meeting.

maria: Closing thread for now — we'll reconvene in the postmortem meeting and finalize RCA sign-off afterwards.
